note: data_in_psi = number of tests.csv rows with gravity_g = 0. gravity_g = 0 is a QABAS convention for microgravity. SAFFIRE-II ran on Cygnus after it left the ISS and is counted here by team decision. o2_pct and pressure_kpa left empty: no source file defines them for the ISS scenario (SAFFIRE-II tests: table O2 21.5 to 22.1 %, measured pressure 102.5 to 102.8 kPa).

data_in_psi = number of tests.csv rows with a 1-g comparison result (outcome_1g not empty). gravity_g = 1 from the source column names "1-g". o2_pct and pressure_kpa left empty: the source does not give the conditions of the 1-g tests.
